title: M1911-style pistol
summary: A newly modelled pistol with moving parts and a seven-round magazine.
notes: Remodel the pistol with a painted steel finish, walnut grips and UV regions for skins.
Add animated slide recoil, empty slide lock and a timed magazine reload using R or controller X.
Show loaded and reserve pistol ammunition on the HUD.
Keep the chamber and barrel interior visible through the ejection port during firing.
